_about: Public-domain Thieleman Janszoon van Braght (1625-1664), Mennonite minister of Dordrecht, for the Word Hoard: the Martyrs Mirror (The Bloody Theatre) in English, in the Lancaster County translation of 1837 and the Elkhart translation of 1886, from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 42 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

braght-martyrs-mirror-1837: The bloody theatre, or, Martyr's mirror, of the defenceless Christians, who suffered and were put to death for the testimony of Jesus, their Savior, from the time of Christ until the year 1660 (Lancster county, Pa. Published by David Miller, 1837)
braght-martyrs-mirror-1886: The bloody theatre, or Martyr's mirror (catalogued 1886)

_excluded.braght-other: Dutch and German editions (1736, 1745, 1780); the 1850 Baptist Martyrology (another work); the modern 2013 reprint
